catalog_quirks.body: Moondream Cloud Free includes $5 per workspace in recurring monthly usage credits, shared across models; usage beyond that allowance is metered. Both listed routes passed live vision and streaming tests through the adapter on 2026-09-22. Images must be base64 data URLs; remote image URLs, tool calling and stop sequences are unsupported. Output is limited by the upstream API to 4096 tokens including reasoning. Context and request-rate limits are not claimed without verification. This uses the hosted BYOK API, not self-hosted weights. Sources: https://moondream.ai/pricing and https://docs.moondream.ai/openai/.
